actor.description: The actor whose key is being emergency-revoked. Must agree with the envelope subject. Cross-actor emergency revocation is invalid.

subject.description: Internal reference of the same actor: 'actor:<self-actor-id>'.

created_at.description: Strict RFC 3339 UTC seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Statements signed by revoked_key with created_at strictly after this time are invalid; if retroactive=true, all such statements are invalid regardless of timing.

revoked_key.description: KeyId of the key whose signing authority is being revoked. Must be a key the envelope actor has held (genesis-initial, an ActorKeyRotation.next_key, or an ActorEmergencyKeyRotation.next_key). Attestation keys are not revocable in v1.

retroactive.description: If true, statements signed by revoked_key are invalid from inception. If false, only statements signed strictly after this revocation's created_at are invalid.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason. Included in canonical bytes.

signatures.description: Each signature must be produced by a distinct key in the actor's attestation set at created_at. The verifier requires >= attestation_threshold_at(actor, created_at) entries with distinct key_id values. See ACTORS.md §5.5.2 / §5.5.3.
